settings.s3TestFailed: S3 connection ошибка. Check your credentials and bucket название.
settings.s3PolicyDescription: Your IAM пользователь needs the following permissions on the S3 bucket. Replace YOUR_BUCKET_NAME with your actual bucket название.
settings.s3BucketPrivateNote: The S3 bucket should not be public. All file access is handled through presigned URLs generated by the server.
settings.s3CorsDescription: Your S3 bucket needs a CORS policy to allow direct file uploads from the browser. добавить this under Bucket > Permissions > CORS. Replace YOUR_FRONTEND_ORIGIN with your dashboard URL (e.g. http://localhost:7100).
settings.pncDescription: When включено, the system manages PKI сертификаты for ISO 15118 Plug and Charge. Disabling hides the сертификаты section and blocks сертификат operations.
settings.pncSaveFailed: ошибка to сохранить Plug & Charge настройки.
settings.recaptchaDescription: reCAPTCHA v3 protects login pages from automated bots. пользователи are scored invisibly without solving puzzles.
settings.recaptchaSecretHint: Stored encrypted on the server. Leave blank to keep the текущий value.
settings.recaptchaThresholdHint: Requests scoring below this value are rejected. Range: 0.0 (allow all) to 1.0 (block most). Recommended: 0.5.
settings.mfaDescription: Multi-factor authentication adds a second verification step during login. Enable методы here to make them доступно system-wide. Individual пользователи and водители enable MFA for themselves via their профиль.
settings.ssoDescription: Configure SAML 2.0 single sign-on with your identity provider.
settings.marketingDescription: Configure Google Analytics tracking for the Portal and CSMS frontends.
settings.gtagHint: Google Analytics measurement ID, e.g. G-XXXXXXXXXX
settings.reservationEnabledDesc: Allow водители to reserve charging коннекторы in advance.
settings.reservationBufferMinutesHelp: Minutes before бронирование starts where no new сессии are allowed
settings.reservationCancellationWindowMinutesHelp: Cancellations within this window incur a fee
settings.reservationCancellationFeeCentsHelp: Fee charged when cancelling within the cancellation window
settings.reservationMaxHoursHelp: Caps the length of any single бронирование window. Default 3.
settings.supportEnabledDesc: Allow водители to submit and view обращения в поддержку.
settings.fleetEnabledDesc: Allow operators to создать and manage fleet accounts.
settings.guestChargingEnabledDesc: Allow unauthenticated пользователи to начать сессии зарядки without an аккаунт.
settings.ocppStationConfigDescription: These values are sent to the станция after each BootNotification. OCPP 2.1 станции receive SetVariables команды. OCPP 1.6 станции receive ChangeConfiguration команды. Values of 0 are not pushed.
settings.ocppMeterValueIntervalHelp: How often the станция отчеты энергия readings during a transaction. Pushed as SampledDataCtrlr.TxUpdatedInterval (2.1) or MeterValueSampleInterval (1.6). Set to 0 to use станция firmware defaults.
settings.ocppClockAlignedIntervalHelp: Interval for clock-aligned meter value reporting at exact время boundaries (e.g. 900 for every 15 minutes on the hour). Pushed as AlignedDataCtrlr.Interval (2.1) or ClockAlignedDataInterval (1.6). Set to 0 to disable.
settings.ocppSampledMeasurandsHelp: Comma-separated measurands reported during активно transactions. Pushed as SampledDataCtrlr.TxUpdatedMeasurands (2.1) or MeterValuesSampledData (1.6).
settings.ocppAlignedMeasurandsHelp: Comma-separated measurands reported at clock-aligned intervals. Pushed as AlignedDataCtrlr.Measurands (2.1) or MeterValuesAlignedData (1.6). Only sent when clock-aligned interval is greater than 0.
settings.ocppTxEndedMeasurandsHelp: Comma-separated measurands included in the final meter value snapshot when a transaction ends. Pushed as SampledDataCtrlr.TxEndedMeasurands (2.1) or StopTxnSampledData (1.6).
settings.ocppBootResponseDescription: These values are returned to the станция in the BootNotification response. The станция reads and applies them automatically.
settings.ocppHeartbeatIntervalHelp: How often the станция sends heartbeat messages to confirm it is still онлайн. Returned as the interval field in the BootNotification response.
settings.ocppCsmsConfigDescription: These настройки control how the CSMS handles OCPP communication. They are not sent to станции.
settings.ocppConnectionTimeoutHelp: How long to wait for a станция to respond to a command before timing out.
settings.ocppResetRetriesHelp: Number of times to retry a Reset command if the станция does not respond.
settings.ocppApprovalRequiredHelp: When включено, new станции are placed in a ожидает state until an operator approves them. When отключено, станции are accepted automatically on first BootNotification.
settings.idlingDescription: Configure how long a транспорт can remain idle before idle fees начать accruing. The grace period delays billing but водители are notified immediately when idling starts.
settings.idleGracePeriodHelp: Set to 0 to начать idle fees immediately. водители are notified as soon as idling begins regardless of this настройка.
settings.sessionDescription: Configure automatic cleanup of stale сессии зарядки. сессии with no activity beyond the timeout are marked as faulted. This handles cases where a станция loses мощность and never sends a transaction end event.
settings.staleSessionTimeoutHelp: сессии with no meter value updates for this duration are automatically closed. Set to 0 to disable automatic cleanup.
settings.pricingDescription: Configure время-of-day тарифы behavior, split billing across тариф boundaries, and тарифы display on станция screens.
settings.splitBillingDesc: When включено, сессии spanning multiple тариф periods are billed per segment using each period's rate.
settings.displayFormatDesc: Format used when showing тарифы information on станция screens.
settings.pushDisplayDesc: Automatically push текущий тарифы information to станция screens every minute.
settings.googleMapsDescription: Configure your Google Maps API key and default map view for станция location displays.
